General comment on data set: This EPD refers to the product HOIZ - wood shaving insulation, manufactured at the factory in 87746 Erkheim, Germany. HOIZ - wood shaving insulation is used as thermal and sound insulation for roofs, ceilings and walls as non-load-bearing cavity insulation in timber construction. In general all cavities in building components (including steel structures) could be insulated or acoustically insulated with it. However, the insulation material is only installed in prefabricated parts in-house and is not delivered separately as a ‘pure’ insulation material. | |
Time representativeness description: The foreground data collected refers to the year 2022. | |
Technology description including backgro: The insulation material consists of wood shavings produced during the planing of various types of softwood from nearby regional sawmills. Pure spruce is mainly used, with small amounts of fir and pine possibly also being used. The shavings are impregnated with whey and soda as a flame retardant and to prevent mould growth.
